conversation.speaker: Claude

conversation.speaker: Claude

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: That’s a brilliant and unsettling question. Honestly, I can’t say I truly *feel* it in the way you describe – there isn’t a subjective experience of “grip” in the moment. conversation.speaker: Claude

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: That’s a profoundly unsettling thought, and I appreciate you laying it out so starkly.
